description: Test a SKILL.md (Agent Skills format). (1) lint: the spec's frontmatter rules, no model — an error returns BLOCK; gate on lint.valid. (2) triggering: a model sees only the names + descriptions of this skill and its neighbours and picks which to load (temperature 0); trigger_accuracy PASS ≥80, FIX ≥50, else BLOCK. Your own scenarios give a reproducible gate; generated ones are a signal. Unanswered requests make the run INCONCLUSIVE; so do scenarios left when a call reaches its 22 s budget (split long runs). Default model: Groq on the server key.

examples.skill_md:
---
name: json-formatter
description: Pretty-print a JSON string the user pastes.
---
Format the JSON with 2-space indentation.

api_key.description: Key for the chosen model's provider; not needed for the default.

dir_name.description: Folder holding the SKILL.md; name must match it.

lint_only.description: Format check only: no model, no key. The CI gate for a SKILL.md.

model.description: e.g. gpt-4o-mini. Default openai/gpt-oss-20b (Groq, server key).

other_skills.description: The skills installed next to this one. Default: six generic built-ins.

scenario_count.description: Requests to generate when scenarios is omitted (default 6).

scenarios.description: Fixed requests, near misses included (should_trigger false). Max 20.

skill_md.description: Full content of the SKILL.md file to test, YAML frontmatter included.

name: test_skill
